text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —The gold is bouncing!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre takes the lead!
Nobody can catch her now!!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
This is the 7th Triple Crown Umamusume!
Orfevre...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Orfevre!
The Classic Triple Crown has been claimed...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Orfevre achieved the Triple Crown, and the world was buzzing with excitement over the birth of a new Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: A girl named Orfevre won the Triple Crown, right? And I hear that Triple Crown thing is a pretty huge deal.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
My grandchild was overjoyed.
And so, I ended up getting hooked on watching the races myself.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's get together sometime and have a Triple Crown gathering!
A watch party for Triple Crown Umamusume races!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds great!
I'll go let everyone know!"

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Rawr! I'm Orfevre!
I'm super strong~~!!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
“My Orfevre is super strong too!
Umm, umm... Triple Crown Beam!”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Orfe-san—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (I still wanted to weave hope...)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(...And yet, as I thought—
my heart, my body remain unchanged...)

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I used to play that game too.
Still... I see, from now on, it's Orfevre's era, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—One day.
Out of the blue, she showed up at the Trainer's Office.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Everywhere I went, I heard people
celebrating the birth of a Triple Crown Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Right after that happened, I never thought
I'd be able to experience such a celebratory atmosphere again.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Orfevre-san has accomplished something truly wonderful, hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It certainly is wonderful.
Yet on the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa!
Victoire Pisa wins it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"My chest aches with the uneasy feeling
that what she accomplished that day
is gradually being forgotten."
choice_data_list: Still, you connected everyone through your racing.
Still, you brought everyone together through your racing.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
choice_data_list: I'm sure going forward, you'll be the one to—
I'm sure going forward, you will be the one to—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
Truly.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: There's something I need to talk to you about.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...I believe you may have already had an inkling.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Ever since achieving what I set out to do in Dubai... it feels as though the thing that had always driven me has simply vanished.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry I couldn't talk to you during the summer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "Perhaps I, too, just wanted to believe that it hadn't disappeared yet."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...However.
Hearing the good news about Orfe-san, and seeing everyone's smiles—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but feel
a profound sense of fulfillment.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Along with memories of the earthquake,
people will probably let me fade into the past, bit by bit.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: “Even so, that is fine. As long as a bond forms between you all, and hope remains.”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't help but feel that way.
I..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Surely, its role has come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I had a feeling.
Deep down, I knew that was the reason
I couldn't go back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Fighting the urge to hang my head in despair,
I look at her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The look on her face
was radiant beyond measure.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Would you run in the Arima Kinen
after the Japan Cup is over?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
And with that, could we perhaps
bring down the curtain here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The words didn't come to me right away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—...If I refuse,
I'm sure she'll push herself just a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has raw talent to begin with. With proper adjustments,
regardless of her mindset, she might be able to reclaim her past form.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"No, she'll be fine.
I know she can win it back. If it's her, she surely will—"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Surely.
choice_data_list: ...All right. Let's call it a day.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "They were a wonderful three years, with no regrets."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We were supposed to be able to
unite the world with hope, too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The press conference announcing Victoire Pisa's
retirement generated quite a bit of buzz.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I will make this year's Arima Kinen my final race.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I will give it my all and run through to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So that not a single shred of regret remains, until the very end...
I must see her off.
